summary.text: Chris Blazejewski is the Democratic Speaker of the Rhode Island House of Representatives, has represented District 2 since 2011, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an attorney and was elected speaker of the House in May 2026.

paragraphs.text: Blazejewski was born in 1979 and raised in Cumberland Hill, Rhode Island, and received a bachelor's degree in social studies and a J.D. from Harvard University in 2002 and 2005, respectively.
As of June 2026 he was an attorney for Sherin and Lodgen LLP, focusing on corporate law, legal malpractice defense and business disputes.
Blazejewski first won election to the Rhode Island House in 2010, defeating independent Richard Rodi in the general election with 70.9% of the vote.
He served as House majority leader from November 2020 to May 2026.
On May 7, 2026, the House elected him speaker, 65-10 along partisan lines, to succeed K. Joseph Shekarchi, who resigned from the role to apply for a position on the state's supreme court.
Ballotpedia quotes him describing himself as a progressive who said the speaker's job is "to include all voices and make sure that they're heard."
